description: What is being done to children in the name of "gender-affirming care" is one of the greatest medical scandals of our generation.
shortAnswer: What is being done to children in the name of "gender-affirming care" is one of the greatest medical scandals of our generation. When a doctor fails to properly diagnose, ignores underlying mental health issues, pushes irreversible treatment, skips meaningful informed consent, or excludes parents, that is not progressive care. That is medical malpractice.

sections.heading: I Am Investigating These Cases Now
sections.shortAnswer: I am actively reviewing cases involving gender-related medical interventions in minors, failure to obtain proper informed consent, exclusion of parents from critical decisions, and long-term harm caused by premature or inappropriate treatment. If the standard of care was violated, we will pursue justice.

faq.q: Can parents take legal action if they were excluded from their child's gender-related medical decisions?
faq.a: Schools, counselors, and providers are making life-altering decisions without full parental involvement, sometimes actively concealing what is happening. That is not just unethical. In many cases, it is legally actionable.

faq.q: What if my child was harmed by puberty blockers, hormones or surgery as a minor?
faq.a: If your child was placed on puberty blockers or hormones at a young age, pushed toward surgical procedures as a minor, treated without your full knowledge or consent, misdiagnosed or rushed through care, and harmed physically or psychologically as a result, you need answers. And you deserve accountability.
